title: Mona Lisa
description: One of the most famous portraits in the world, known for its mysterious smile.

title: The Starry Night
museum: Museum of Modern Art, New York
description: A powerful painting showing a swirling night sky over a quiet village.

title: Girl with a Pearl Earring
description: A beautiful portrait sometimes called the Mona Lisa of the North.

title: The Great Wave off Kanagawa
description: A famous Japanese woodblock print showing a huge wave near Mount Fuji.

title: The Arnolfini Portrait
description: A detailed domestic portrait filled with symbols, reflections, and fine oil painting technique.

title: Las Meninas
description: A complex royal court painting that plays with perspective, reflection, and the role of the viewer.

title: The Persistence of Memory
museum: Museum of Modern Art, New York
description: A landmark Surrealist painting known for its melting clocks and dreamlike desert landscape.

title: The School of Athens
description: A masterpiece of Renaissance balance showing great philosophers in an ideal classical space.

title: Impression, Sunrise
description: The painting that gave Impressionism its name, showing light, atmosphere, and a loose brush style.

title: Lady with an Ermine
description: A refined Renaissance portrait showing Cecilia Gallerani holding an ermine, admired for its quiet movement and psychological presence.

title: The Night Watch
description: A dramatic group portrait known for its theatrical light, motion, and civic guard composition.

title: Portrait of Charles I
description: A commanding royal portrait that presents Charles I with Baroque grandeur, authority, and theatrical presence.

title: Portrait of Innocent X
description: A penetrating papal portrait admired for its psychological intensity, red tonal range, and direct gaze.

title: The Laughing Cavalier
description: A lively Baroque portrait known for its confident pose, ornate costume, and famously animated expression.

title: Water Lilies
description: A luminous study of reflections, floating lilies, and atmospheric color from Monet's garden series.

title: The Fighting Temeraire
description: A poetic scene of an old warship being towed at sunset, balancing industrial change with fading naval glory.

title: Rain, Steam and Speed
description: A dynamic vision of a train cutting through mist and weather, turning modern speed into atmosphere and motion.

title: Wheatfield with Cypresses
museum: Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York
description: A vibrant landscape where wheat, cypress trees, and swirling clouds create a charged sense of light and movement.

title: Fine Wind, Clear Morning
museum: Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York
description: A bold view of Mount Fuji, also known as Red Fuji, with clear sky and warm color shaping a calm monumental landscape.

title: Ejiri in Suruga Province
description: A windswept scene from Hokusai's Mount Fuji series, contrasting human motion with Fuji's still presence.

title: Evening Snow at Kanbara
description: A quiet snowbound village from Hiroshige's Tokaido series, known for its restrained palette and night atmosphere.

title: Thunderstorm Beneath the Summit
description: A dramatic Mount Fuji print, also called Black Fuji, where lightning and dark cloud forms create a tense mountain scene.

title: Hunters in the Snow
description: A winter landscape where returning hunters, village life, and distant ice create one of Bruegel's most atmospheric scenes.

title: The Peasant Wedding
description: A vivid rural celebration that turns everyday communal life into a carefully observed Northern Renaissance composition.

title: Self-Portrait
description: A frontal self-portrait by Durer that presents the artist with unusual dignity, symmetry, and controlled detail.

title: Young Hare
description: A precise watercolor study admired for its natural detail, delicate fur texture, and close observation.

title: Portrait of Erasmus of Rotterdam
description: A refined scholar portrait that captures Erasmus through restrained pose, sharp drawing, and quiet intellectual focus.
